note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our children's literacy program received a $250,000 grant and the interim report to the funder is due next month.

answers.common.decision: What the interim report should say about progress and spending; the executive director signs it off.
answers.common.audience: The executive director and the funder's program officer.
answers.common.materials: We have spent $140,000 so far. We committed to tutor 400 children this year and have reached 320. The funder allows up to 10% of the grant to move between budget lines without approval.
answers.legal-contracts-procurement.documents: The grant agreement and our budget tracker.
answers.legal-contracts-procurement.reviewer: Our executive director reviews every funder report.
